news.title: Google's Gemini app for Windows 11 uses the same keyboard shortcut as Copilot
news.description: Google just released a dedicated Gemini app for Windows, but it steps on Copilot’s toes right out of the box by claiming Alt + Space.

news.title: N.B. university's Wabanaki Centre welcomes students back with arts, food and drumming
news.description: A Wabanaki welcome back gathering at St. Thomas University in Fredericton brought students, local artists and drum groups together to celebrate culture and strengthen Indigenous belonging on-campus.

news.title: The 9/11 Conspiracy Theories
news.description: Michael Shermer takes on the 9/11 Truther movement—melting steel, Pentagon missiles, stand-down orders, suspicious stock trades—dismantling each claim with hard science and demolition-expert testimony, then delivers a sly twist: 9/11 really was a conspiracy, …

news.title: NASA Boosts Open Science, Data Sharing with Artemis Accords
news.description: The science from every Moon rock sample, lunar dataset, and discovery produced through NASA’s Artemis program will be shared by the agency with the global scientific community. That commitment is upheld by all 71 countries that have signed the Artemis Accords…
